definitions.explanation: A fundamental building block in electronics or technology, such as a transistor, diode, or sensor. Refers to a discrete functional unit within a larger system.

examples.japanese: ⟦{半導体|はんどうたい}→半導体：09248_handoutai⟧{素子|そし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{向上|こうじょう}した→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧。
examples.english: The performance of semiconductor devices has improved.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{回路|かいろ}→回路：12038_kairo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{複数|ふくすう}→複数：14236_fukusuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{素子|そし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This circuit is composed of multiple components.

examples.japanese: {受光|じゅこう}{素子|そし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦センサー→センサー：29781_sensaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心的|ちゅうしんてき}→中心的：05676_chuushinteki⟧な⟦{役割|やくわり}を{果|は}たす→役割を果たす：19503_yakuwariwohatasu⟧。
examples.english: The photosensitive element plays a central role in the camera sensor.

notes:
Composed of {素|そ} (element, base) and {子|し} (small thing, child). In electronics and physics, {素子|そし} refers to an individual functional component. The character {子|し} here functions as a suffix indicating a small discrete unit, similar to its use in ⟦{粒子|りゅうし}→粒子：14970_ryuushi⟧ (particle) or ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧ (electron).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{半導体|はんどうたい}→半導体：09248_handoutai⟧{素子|そし}: semiconductor device
- {受光|じゅこう}{素子|そし}: light-receiving element, photosensor
- ⟦{発光|はっこう}→発光：17472_hakkou⟧{素子|そし}: light-emitting element
- {素子|そし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{集積|しゅうせき}: integration of components

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧: part, component — a general word for mechanical or electronic parts
- ⟦{要素|ようそ}→要素：03661_youso⟧: element, factor — used more abstractly for constituent elements of a concept or system
- ⟦{電子|でんし}→電子：03449_denshi⟧: electron — shares the {子|し} suffix but refers specifically to the subatomic particle
